correctness.rationale: The proof combines explicit Laplace-saddle shell concentration with a uniform Jacobi-moment construction. The shell endpoints and exponent gaps, the uniform tail estimate for the local probes, and the multiplicity-free U(n) commutant identification were checked separately. The conclusion is norm density, not single-symbol surjectivity.

originality.rationale: The closest 2026 source for the same logarithmic weight constructs one alternating asymptotic eigenvalue sequence in one dimension and concludes failure of the classical square-root-metric description. Searches of the source, classical Fock radial sequence-algebra literature, standard weighted Bergman analogues, and synonymous full-diagonal/norm-closure formulations found no arbitrary bounded interpolation plus c0 recovery theorem or full ell-infinity norm saturation.

value.rationale: The result identifies the radial Toeplitz C*-algebra exactly with the full U(n)-commutant for the logarithmic weight, strengthens a single oscillatory counterexample to arbitrary bounded sequence norm approximation, extends to every complex dimension, and identifies the compact ideal and corona quotient.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, formal verification, or a guarantee of first discovery.
